name: token-usage-inspector
description: Inspect current and historical token usage across local Codex tasks and projects.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect local Codex usage by task, project, model, and date
interface.longDescription: Read native token_usage_record events and reconstruct older cumulative token_count logs. Report per-turn, per-call, task, project, model, day, or month usage from active and archived local rollouts, with CSV/JSON export and live watch.
defaultPrompt: Show token usage for this Codex task.
Summarize all historical token usage for this project by month and model.
Inspect token usage for every locally retained Codex task.
Watch the current task's token usage live.
